protocol_notes: These are project analysis windows, not competition minimum collection durations.
The original 17 October 30-minute holdout remained incomplete. Its available first 20 minutes are explicitly exploratory here; 18 October never fills its missing buckets.
This final protocol was documented after collection. It is not a prospectively registered experiment; held-out outcomes are excluded from fitting and model selection.
Deduplicate by OD and global five-minute wall-clock bucket, keeping the first API-success response. A later duplicate never repairs missing ETA or geometry in that first success.
The cross-day window starts off the wall-clock bucket grid: its 24 expected samples are cadence slots, not a claim that every partially intersected wall-clock bucket is sampled.
Default identifiable ETA state is the per-OD training median. The nonnegative shared affine ETA model is a research comparator; holdout results do not choose the deployed model.
SUMO mechanism parameters remain assumptions. Platform ETA is a route estimate, not observed vehicle travel time, flow or signal timing.
